name: Marion Miller
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a holistic counsellor and coach who combines mindfulness-based, ecotheraputic and depth psychology in my sessions. I've have been teaching mindfulness for over two decades and trained in MBSR. I like to shift clients from an individualistic mindset towards a more ecological worldview that provides context and clarity and less pathologising when seeking greater understanding and awareness of their current challenges.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Joan Burchell-Quirk
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Joan specialises in victims of sexual assault, children & adolescents who display harmful sexualised behaviours, complex trauma, mental health, the LGBTIQA+ community & relationship dynamics. Joan holds a Master of Counselling & Psychotherapy and works from various frameworks: including trauma informed, psychodynamic, interpersonal, client centred and also systemic. Joan uses a diverse range of therapies such as schema therapy, sand play therapy, EMDR & psychodynamic therapy.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Kevin Scott
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Gestalt Therapist, Family Therapist Pain Reprocessing Therapy Deep Brain Reorienting
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Voahirana Reineck
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Shalom Peace Counselling’s mission is to help you reach your goals for a more integrated and whole life using integrative counselling approaches. Shalom is rooted in Christian values that respects the free will of everyone. Shalom also rests on an intercultural platform, with curiosity to know and appreciate your unique background.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

name: Lisa Moseley
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a qualified therapist of over 20 years, working with individuals, families and groups throughout all stages of life. The principles of my work promote agency, creative initiative, empowerment, and prioritize compassion for self and others. Professional supervision services: "Dwelling Reflective Practices", integrate narrative therapy with mindfulness and expression to develop intuitive connections and flow through the process - of reconnecting and bringing your authentic choices to life.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Rowenna Halge
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Rowenna practices a form of counselling and psychotherapy that: · Acknowledges that it is unlikely that anyone of us will avoid an experience of some difficulty, isolation, illness, loss or meaninglessness as part of our life. · Offers a relational therapy that provides an attuned presence, empathy and support at these difficult times and in the unfolding process of your personal exploration, healing and growth. · Engages in a collaborative process of inquiry and exploration that includes taking into account the full context of your life – social and cultural background, environment, circumstances, relationships, present resources and capacity. · Helps you develop self-understanding that comes from present centred awareness of your experience and your relationship with others. · Allows you to develop a capacity to bring about changes in yourself and your life through understanding and awareness. · Explores the way your past experience and your hopes for the future may influence or inform your present experience. · Encourages moving from limiting patterns of responding and relating to a capacity to respond to your life circumstances creatively and with a sense of conscious choice.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Claudia Rossi
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Are you seeking a compassionate and creative way to overcome obstacles that keep you from moving forward in your life? A Trauma-Informed, Strengths-Based and Person-Centred approach responds to your needs in each session, providing a safe, supportive and affirming way through therapy. My areas of experience are Mental Health including Trauma, Anxiety, Depression, BiPolar Disorder, Schizophrenia, Dissociative Disorders, BPD, Grief & Loss, ADHD, Neurodiversity, Disability, Autism & Sensory Processing Disorders, Alcohol and Substance Abuse, Serious & Chronic illness, building Self-Agency, Self-Esteem, Self-Awareness and Personal Development, Wellbeing, Mindfulness, Creative Expression and overcoming obstacles to creativity.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Sandra Buchanan
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
practice: Sandra Buchanan - Counsellor, Arts Therapist, Accredited Supervisor
description: A Clinical Counsellor, Therapist, and Accredited Supervisor, qualified in the use of expressive arts therapies. I bring to my practice an empathetic person-centred approach, evidence-based support for those experiencing trauma, drawing on over 10 years in private practice, my own lived experiences, and mindfulness practice. My strength lies in relationship and meaningful support of others, both with individuals and groups.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy
